source_ref: INVENTED glue serving story.csv act_iv (side with a faction); endings §3.3 (the Barbarian ending — abandon the river lands; no single king: the council of warlords); endings.csv:ending_3_barbarian (the price stands in canon); notes L33-37; people.csv:the_warchief (referenced by title only; his name stays OPEN); dialogues.csv:envoy_warchief_price (there is no crown among us); dialogues.csv:breaking_herald_terms_read (the answer when the grass yellows); deepens newcomers_from_the_east (act_i); the_village_on_the_eastern_road (act_iii); game-design §11.13 (the ending's unlock stands OPEN — nothing here unlocks it) — the road out: the envoy who once named prices in a back room of the harbour beerhouse comes again, and the price named now is everything he has built on the river; the council of the eastern roads offers a place among the strong, and the road to it passes the river lands by — to take it is to abandon the river lands: the fields he bought in before the raiders could burn them, the levy lists he kept short, the bread he stood at the gates; the council does not promise fire and does not promise anything at all; there is no crown among them — there is the strong, and the councils the strong sit in, and a place in the gathering of strong individuals is the whole of what is offered; the road stands open until the grass yellows
